import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20]['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=20, color='#2E86AB', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
mean_age = age_data.mean()
ax2.axvline(mean_age, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean Age: {mean_age:.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(district_counts))
bars = ax3.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index, fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Dog Gender and Owner Gender Breakdown
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation
gender_crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_crosstab.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#E63946', '#457B9D'], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
